title: ‘It's awful’: How tariffs, soaring fuel costs and higher interest rates are squeezing American companies
summary: American companies are currently facing significant challenges due to a combination of tariffs, soaring fuel costs, and rising interest rates. These factors are particularly impacting sectors such as manufacturing, auto supply, retail, and transportation. As a result, businesses are struggling to maintain profitability and competitiveness in an increasingly difficult economic environment.
shadowing: Tariffs are impacting the cost structure of many companies.
Soaring fuel prices are affecting transportation costs significantly.
Higher interest rates are making borrowing more expensive for businesses.
Manufacturers are being squeezed by increased operational costs.
Retailers are struggling to pass on costs to consumers.
